name: 24641 · Richlands, VA
findings: ZIP 24641 (Richlands) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24641 (Richlands) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
